name: Arcana
description: The domain of innate and elemental magic. Arcana wielders shape raw arcane forces — fire, storm, time, and otherwise — through instinct and force of will rather than study.

name: Blade
description: The domain of weapons and warfare. Blade wielders excel at dealing damage in melee or at range, turning martial skill into devastating attacks.

name: Bone
description: The domain of hunters, scouts, and tacticians. Bone wielders read the battlefield, move with precision, and exploit the rhythms of combat.

name: Codex
description: The domain of learned magic and arcane texts. Codex wielders study and recall ancient writings, weaving their lore into measured, deliberate spells.

name: Grace
description: The domain of charm, performance, and social maneuvering. Grace wielders move through crowds and conversations with calculated ease.

name: Midnight
description: The domain of stealth, shadow, and secrets. Midnight wielders strike from concealment, slip past attention, and bend shadow to their will.

name: Sage
description: The domain of nature, growth, and the wild. Sage wielders draw on the living world — plants, beasts, and the cycles of the wild — for both insight and power.

name: Splendor
description: The domain of light, healing, and renewal. Splendor wielders mend wounds, banish darkness, and shore up the spirits of their allies.

name: Valor
description: The domain of protection, courage, and resilience. Valor wielders shield their allies, take blows meant for others, and inspire their companions to hold the line.
